test_title: PYST 25: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Nayan asked, “Can I call you back tomorrow?”

options.text: Nayan asked if he could call me back tomorrow.
Nayan asked if he should call me back tomorrow.
Nayan asked if he can call me back tomorrow
Nayan asked if he could call me back the next day.

solution:
The correct answer is "**Nayan asked if he could call me back the next day."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To convert the given sentence from **direct speech to reported speech:** 

 
 
• we use the **reporting verb "asked**" in the **past tense**,
 
• change the **pronoun** "**I**" to "**he**", and convert the **modal verb "can**" to "**could**" to **indicate a polite request**.
 
• Therefore, the correct **reported speech** sentence would be "**Nayan asked if he could call me back the next day**."
 
 
 
• **Option 2** changes the meaning of the sentence by using the **modal verb "should**" instead of "**can/could**", which is **not appropriate** in this context.
 
• **Option 3** uses the **present tense** "**can**" instead of the **past tense** "**could**" which is **not correct** in **reported speech**.
 
• **Option 1 **does not change the phrase "**tomorrow**" to "**the next day**" which makes it **incorrect**.

Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer.
